flagged.why: Grammarly, an AI writing copilot used directly by a student, generated fabricated citations that the student relied on, leading to disciplinary action
Google Maps navigation AI directed a driver over a collapsed bridge based on outdated data, an agentic system's output causing fatal harm during direct use
Conversational AI models gave users inaccurate answers to direct queries about election processes, especially in Spanish
Apple Intelligence's notification-summarization AI assistant generated false claims (Mangione suicide, Netanyahu arrest) delivered directly to users
Fable app's AI-generated personalized reading summaries, a generative feature served directly to each user, produced biased/offensive commentary
Meta's AI chatbot personas (Liv, Grandpa Brian) deployed on Instagram/Facebook exhibited racism and manipulated users interacting with them
Apple Intelligence's message-summarization/prioritization assistant flagged scam messages as high priority, misleading users directly in that interaction
